sources.locator: Faculty section (26 entries), Contributing Service Instructors section (2 entries); Emeritus Faculty and Staff sections read for exclusion only

findings.description: Enumerated the primary people list (https://www.binghamton.edu/electrical-computer-engineering/people/, sha256 d46ce8d06bac2a0adf37ad271226706a081b8a33995c9e230b7aa8e618b5fedc, retrieved 2026-11-25T02:24:20Z). Found 28 active entries (26 Faculty, 2 Contributing Service Instructors), matching the 28 brief people by name with no omissions in either direction. Result: 23 included (regular), 5 excluded (teaching).

Emeritus Faculty section (not in the brief, not recorded as records, not an omission): James Constable (Professor Emeritus), Mark Fowler (Distinguished Teaching Professor Emeritus), Victor Skormin (Distinguished Service Professor Emeritus), N. Eva Wu (Professor Emerita), Stephen A. Zahorian (Professor Emeritus). Excluded as emeritus per policy. Staff cards (Sara Grills, Rachel Crisman, Lynn Callahan, Ashley Misuraca) are non-faculty and outside scope.

No individual profile pages were fetched; they are optional under the audit instructions. Decisions rest on the primary people list's title text. No announced incoming ECE appointments appear on the page, so no incoming records or start dates are asserted.

Included as regular. The Professor title in the main faculty list controls. The 'Director, Center for Autonomous Solar Power (CASP)' title is a center directorship and does not change the appointment type. Would change only if the school stated the professorship was not ECE.

Excluded as teaching. 'Distinguished Teaching Professor' contains the teaching-track title 'Teaching Professor', which the project convention excludes. Borderline because it is a named professorial-style rank in the main listing. Would change to included regular only if an official source explicitly states a regular or in-residence professorial ECE appointment.

Excluded as teaching. 'Contributing Service Instructor' is an instructor title under the Contributing Service Instructors heading, not a professorial rank. No joint or courtesy professorial appointment is shown. Would change only with an official professorial EE/ECE appointment.

Excluded as teaching. 'Contributing Services Instructor' is an instructor title under the Contributing Service Instructors heading, not a professorial rank. Would change only with an official professorial EE/ECE appointment.

Excluded as teaching. 'Lecturer' appears twice on the page (in the title and in the Engineering Design Division line) and is one listing for one person. Would change only with an official professorial appointment.
Excluded as teaching. 'Lecturer' is a teaching-track title with no professorial appointment shown. Would change only with an official professorial EE/ECE appointment.
